title: Contest Evaluation Methods
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CONTEST EVALUATION METHODS
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, exact length and end marker; exact independent left/right payload match
versions.startupSource:
5 DEFINT A-Z
10 CLS
20 PRINT"TESTING OF VARIOUS METHODS OF EVALUATION"
30 INPUT"HOW MANY CONTESTANTS";NC
40 INPUT"HOW MANY SECTIONS   ";NS
50 INPUT"HOW MANY ROUNDS     ";NR
60 INPUT"HOW MANY IN FINAL ROUND";NF
70 DIM R(NC), S(NS,-INT(-NC/NS)),F(NC),P(6)
80 '
90 FOR RD=1TO NR
95 C=0
100 FOR M=1TO -INT(-NC/NS)

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
